static_traits.name: Liu Haili
static_traits.medical_history: 既往not yet接受心理治疗或咨询;without明显躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度较好,语气平和且能进行Reflection;自我评价偏低,常用灾难化与非黑即白的表述;语速正常

basic_info.main_problem: 我经常觉得自己在很多事情上是最差的,尤其在自认为失败之后.这种not足感和自我批评影响了我的自信与整体幸福感.
basic_info.core_demands: 当我注意到这些without能感影响我的赛车职业表现并影响我与家人的关系时,我决定寻求咨询.
growth_experiences: 一次钓鱼之旅中仅钓到一条很小的鱼.该经历发生时自己对表现有较高期待,压力水平为中等;事后产生强烈的Self-deprecation与without能感(如'我是最差的Fisherman'),并且这种感觉在之后任何自认为失败的情境中都会被激活,影响到生活与职业表现.
过去在赛车After losing a competition也会出现类似的without能感与自我批评;虽然有支持性的家庭,但并not yet主动向家人讨论这些感受.长期以来,这样的体验加重了对失败的敏感,影响职业表现,自尊以及对兴趣爱好的享受.

special_situations.event: On the most recent fishing trip, caught only one very small fish
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not达到自己设定的高期待或have not显著成果,就等于失败并证明我是最差的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to relieve negative feelings by rationalizing and focusing on own successes, but with limited effect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am the worst fisherman / I have completely failed at this

special_situations.event: After losing a car race or making a small mistake
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的表现not完美,就说明我not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistent self-criticism,反复沉浸在错误中,难以专注于改进

special_situations.event: Situations where family interaction and relationships are affected
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在Work或兴趣上表现not佳,就会让家人失望并破坏关系
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing real feelings with family to avoid conflict or being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 都是我not好,关系变糟是因为我

special_situations.event: When considering trying cognitive restructuring or behavioral experiments (fishing again, writing thought records)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能有效地做到认知重构,就证明我确实是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitating and lowering expectations, but still willing to try
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 万一我做not好怎么办?我可能还是会失败

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as capable, recognized and respected (proving oneself in career and family)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败后被negate,被贴上'最差'的标签并伤害重要关系
defense_goal: Avoids failure and being judged through harsh self-criticism and high expectations
对家人保持not披露内心感受以减少暴露脆弱与冲突

object_relations.self_representation: not称职的失败者,需要not断证明自己的个体
object_relations.object_representation: A harsh judge (competitions, others, or family evaluating worth by results)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a behavioral experiment (fishing again) or assigns the homework of writing a thought record
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 若not能完美完成这些任务,就再次证明自己是失败者(将练习视为能力与价值的考验)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use a supportive and normalizing tone, affirm the reasonableness of their worries, invite them to break goals into executable small steps, and emphasize the learning nature of practice rather than success-failure judgment.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling or facing a game loss or a mistake and emotions rise
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning negative evaluations and pressure from the outside into attacks on oneself, believing everything is one's own problem
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone is gentle and firm; helps them identify the content and sources of self-criticism, encouraging replacing blame with concrete behavioral improvements and compassionate self-talk.

manifestations: 拥有支持性的家庭却not yet向家人讨论自身的without能感与困扰
After failure, tends to self-criticize and bear emotions alone
outcomes: Reduced sense of interpersonal connection,Relationship tension

manifestations: 在兴趣爱好(如钓鱼)中因结果not佳而难以享受过程
Tightly binding individual worth with performance outcomes
outcomes: Sensitivity to failure increases; emotional distress intensifies

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Sets high expectations for fishing and competitions, regarding 'must have outstanding results' as the standard for measuring self-worth
Tightly binds performance to self-worth, hard to digest and integrate failure experiences

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-criticism after failure, hard to focus on improvement
对尝试认知重构与行为实验持谨慎与怀疑态度,担心做not好

positive_force: Has a supportive family and a foundation of social support
Willing to try behavioral experiments and thought-record homework
能够识do not并承认积极方面(例如承认自己确实钓到鱼,天气与体验有积极面)
negative_force: 灾难化与Black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization与心理过滤
Avoids expressing real feelings in important relationships, worried about being judged

target_behavior.behavior: 在自认为失败后出现强烈的Self-denial与自我批评
antecedent: Only catching small fish when fishing
Losing a race or making small mistakes
When facing situations that require trying cognitive restructuring or behavioral experiments
target_behavior.core_reason: Highly outcome-dependent self-worth evaluation (high expectations, perfectionism) acts together with cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, black-and-white, mental filtering, overgeneralization
target_behavior.function: 通过自我批评来获得对失败的'控制感'与预防再次失败的错觉,同时逃避面对not完美与not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: Professional performance affected,Strained relationships with family members,对兴趣爱好的满足感降低,Anxiety与without能感加剧
